testing_centers.notes: All exams taken online through Dynatrace University platform. No external proctoring required for most exams.

id_requirements: Dynatrace account required. No external ID verification for standard assessments.
exam_rules: Online self-administered. Open to all with a Dynatrace University account. Closed-book unless otherwise specified.
renewal_options: Certifications valid for 2 years. Renew by retaking the current version of the exam through Dynatrace University.

retake_policy.notes: Wait 24 hours between attempts. Exams are free; no cost for retakes.

official_study_resources.title: Dynatrace University
official_study_resources.notes: Free online learning paths aligned to certification exams

lifecycle.summary: Confirmed current on the issuer host on 2026-09-23: Dynatrace University's Associate certification learning plan says 'The Dynatrace Associate Certification Learning Plan provides a clear, structured path to help learners build the foundational knowledge needed to understand and work effectively with the Dynatrace platform.' and 'Once learners feel ready, they can conveniently schedule their certification exam directly from the learning plan.', with three mandatory courses ('Dynatrace Associate Certification Exam Preparation Guide', 'Dynatrace Associate Certification Study Guide', 'Dynatrace Associate Certification - Practice Simulations'). Dynatrace University's catalogue lists exactly three certification learning plans: Administration Professional, Associate and Implementation Professional.
